messages:
alex: Heads-up — noisy GPU memory alerts are paging again overnight. Most are very short flares that resolve within a minute.
maya: ugh. is that the per-pod gpu mem ratio alert? any example rule we can look at?
alex: yep, this one:

```yaml
- alert: GpuMemoryPressure
  expr: sum by(node)(gpu_memory_used_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes) > 0.92
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

ravi: quick thoughts: 1m is too short for pages. either increase `for:` to 3-5m or debounce via a recording rule (avg_over_time or increase). also group alerts by nodepool instead of node.
jin: we currently group by node which explodes counts when a single node flares multiple pods. group_key change would collapse noise. also consider using `quantile_over_time` or `avg_over_time` so momentary spikes don't trip it.
ops-manager: operational constraint: paging during business hours only unless it affects >2 racks. Can we make routing rules that only page on sustained or cross-rack impact?
maya: propose two-tier: if sustained >5m OR affected_nodes_count > 2 => severity=page, else severity=ticket. we'll add a recording rule for `nodepool_high_mem_count` and use that in Alertmanager routing.
alex: also want regional mute windows: eu-night (02:00-04:00 CET) should ticket-only unless high-impact. can we add scheduled mute_time_intervals per region?
ravi: yes Alertmanager supports mute_time_intervals. we route to opsgenie with `oncall-pager` receiver for high impact. low-impact goes to `ticketing` receiver.
jin: example route snippet:

```yaml
route:
  receiver: 'ticketing'
  group_by: ['nodepool']
  routes:
  - match:
      impact: 'high'
    receiver: 'oncall-pager'
  - match_re:
      region: 'eu-.*'
    mute_time_intervals: ['eu-night']
```

maya: for debounce I want to add a recording rule:

```promql
avg_over_time(sum by(node)(gpu_memory_used_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes)[5m])
```

and then alert if that recording rule > 0.9 for 5m.

ravi: that will reduce pages a lot. we should also update the SLO dashboard to show paged vs ticketed incidents (weekly oncall burn). jin, please add a panel breaking down alert counts by route label.

jin: will do. i'll also change alert `for:` to 5m in the PR unless anyone objects.

ops-manager: sounds good. make sure the change has a rollout plan: deploy alerting -> 24h observe -> update routing. keep rollback ready to previous rule.
maya: i'll open PRs: one for recording rules + alert `for: 5m`, one for Alertmanager routing + mute_time_intervals. assigning review to @ravi. :thumbsup:
ravi: ack, will review today. also pls include a short test playbook for oncall so we know what will page after the change.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-134 (auto-ticket) — added to ops queue
